policy.single_light: Any one clear automatic lamp source resolves the touch; no confidence/N-of-3 voting.
policy.double_light: Movement, lunge and extension onset alone never decide priority. A very strong lamp-anchored speed advantage must exceed 1.70 body-heights/s in both 0.35s and 0.75s windows with the same direction; otherwise review.
policy.simultaneous: A confirmed simultaneous double light produces no point for either side; absence of confirmation remains review.
policy.blade: Visible guard/tip, contact and parry candidates are supporting evidence only at current model quality.
policy.safety: Missing evidence is not converted into negative evidence.

verdict.reason: Very strong lamp-anchored speed advantage exceeds the automatic margin in both 0.35s and 0.75s windows.
